basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast based in Boston, Massachusetts. I recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science and am currently working as a junior software developer. I'm passionate about building custom PCs and getting into gaming. In my free time, I enjoy experimenting with terrariums and spending time in nature. I'm single and tend to browse Reddit mostly in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational knowledge of computer hardware and software from my CS degree and personal projects. I'm currently expanding my understanding of gaming PCs and game development. Most of my learning is self-taught through online tutorials and community forums.
